text:
maya: FYI merged Pelorus LoRA v2 into customer branch, quick-eval shows weird number tokenization causing invoice EMR drop (~0.84 vs baseline 0.90).

maya: prompt: "Summarize invoice 2023-09-14 total amount"
response (prod): "Total: $12,345.67"
response (merged): "Total: $12,345 . 67"  <-- extra space and occasional digit loss

ravi: can we confirm tokenizer used during LoRA training? sounds like a token split mismatch. @elena

elena: check shows Pelorus trained with tok-v3 (custom merges). merge happened against main/tokenizer.json (tok-v2). quick test: `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; print(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('pelorus/tok-v3').encode('12,345.67'))"`

maya: result: tok-v3 -> [1012, 58, 345, 332, 77], tok-v2 -> [1012, 58345, 33277]. different splits -> KV cache alignment shift -> token-level outputs move.
tj: can we retokenize eval set to tok-v3 and re-run quickpack before any rollback? cheap check.
opsbot: CI job started: job/eng-ml/eval-pelorus/3798765432
maya: re-eval with tok-v3: EMR 0.897 (close to baseline). so evaluation tokenization explains most of the drop.
ravi: good catch. root cause = tokenizer mismatch at merge. how did merge pick wrong tokenizer?
maya: merge script defaulted to main tokenizer because LoRA metadata lacked tokenizer ref. options: 1) re-merge using pelorus tokenizer, 2) add tokenizer pin in LoRA metadata and re-run onboarding CI, 3) pin customer deployment to previous model until validation added.
tj: propose (2) + (3). add pre-merge tokenizer-compat check.
elena: will add heuristic: sample 1k numeric tokens and compute split_ratio; flag if > 5% difference. also add note to quick-eval README to always use training tokenizer.
maya: opening PR to fail merges without tokenizer ref and to add re-merge script for Pelorus. will push canary after CI.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: merged/pelorus-lora-v2 -> canary-1 (awaiting manual approval)
ravi: timeline? need customer validation today.
maya: aiming for canary in ~2h, will update here and ping @ravi. thanks :thumbsup:
tj: nice find. :party_parrot:
__notes: Pelorus LoRA v2 merge caused numeric tokenization regressions due to tokenizer mismatch; team re-ran quick-eval with training tokenizer, added metadata pin and pre-merge checks. Thread in Slack style with short messages, inline commands, and bot notices.
